column1: # What the site's composer draws a part no code point names with, where the composer holds no cut of it; see
#   scripts/part_donor_candidates.py and apps/review/tools/part-donor-sheets.mjs. Each candidate (a description in
#   encoded characters, a cut from another character, a single character the tables confirm the part as, or
#   BabelStone's own glyph of the part) was composed into characters holding the part, each one's own glyph
#   excluded so the composer had to build it, and kept only where it drew well in all of them. An empty drawing:
#   none did, and the part shows as text.
# columns: id, drawing, characters compared, note
